name: Mass Effect 3: Endings Edition
source:
A very dodgy, very short little interactive version of the endings that allows for a number of different outcomes depending on the choices you make. None of them are SUPER happy, and the basic structure is very similar to the game (anything else would require too much writing :)) but there's certainly room for better outcomes (and worse ones) if you play your cards right.

[From [url=http://archiveofourown.org/works/364928]Archive of Our Own[/url]]
translation:
一个非常狡猾、非常短的互动版本的结局，根据你所做的选择，会产生许多不同的结果。他们都不是超级高兴，而且基本结构与游戏非常相似（其他任何东西都需要太多的编写:)），但如果你正确地发挥你的牌，肯定有更好的结果（和更糟糕的结果）的空间。

[来自[url=http://archiveofourown.org/works/364928]我们自己的档案[/url]]
